newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble dips on earlier T-bill selling, injections.
newsitem.headline: Rouble dips on earlier T-bill selling, injections.

text.p: The rouble eased on Thursday after a brief early rise and dealers said rouble offer had been generally high after last weeks' injections from the central bank and the Treasury bill market.
roubles/dollar Mar 27 midday Mar 27 early Mar 26 close

"Earlier this month banks were selling part of their T-bill portfolio (when yields were high). The central bank sold many roubles to banks at the time. Roubles could be sufficient for these reasons," one dealer said.
Other dealers found it difficult to specify sources of rouble funds, given rising prices of government securities.
